subject: packages/core/approvals/src/SubmitForReviewUseCase.ts

blocks: packages/core/brand-kit/tests/unit/UpsertBrandKitUseCase.test.ts::returns ok when upserting with no colors (update metadata only)
subject: packages/core/brand-kit/src/UpsertBrandKitUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The color validation loses its undefined guard, so an upsert that omits every color fails the hex check and returns VALIDATION_FAILED.

blocks: packages/core/bulk-scheduling/tests/unit/ConfirmBulkScheduleUseCase.test.ts::blocks rows where content exceeds the provider's character cap
subject: packages/core/bulk-scheduling/src/ConfirmBulkScheduleUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The block's title names a character cap the use case does not check; its verdict is that a structurally valid row on an owned channel is confirmed. The ownership filter is inverted, so an owned channel reads as foreign and the confirm returns FORBIDDEN.

subject: packages/core/bulk-scheduling/src/ConfirmBulkScheduleUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The branch on the Unit of Work is swapped, so a use case built without one dereferences it and returns INTERNAL_ERROR, while one built with it writes outside a transaction.

blocks: packages/core/customer-auth/tests/unit/CompleteCustomerMfaLoginUseCase.test.ts::mints a session on a valid backup code
subject: packages/core/customer-auth/src/CompleteCustomerMfaLoginUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The verification check gains a condition that refuses a second factor verified by a backup code, so a valid backup code returns INVALID_CHALLENGE and mints no session; a TOTP code is unaffected.

blocks: packages/core/domain/tests/unit/ScheduledTime.test.ts::constructs successfully for a date 10 minutes in the future
subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/ScheduledTime.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The minimum lead time becomes 15 minutes, so a date 10 minutes ahead is refused with a lead time error.

blocks: packages/core/domain/tests/unit/ScheduledTime.test.ts::constructs from a valid ISO string that is 10 minutes ahead
subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/ScheduledTime.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The guard of fromISOString is inverted, so a valid ISO string is refused as an invalid ISO date string.

subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/ScheduledTime.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. fromNowPlusMinutes converts minutes as seconds, so ten minutes ahead becomes ten seconds and is refused with a lead time error.

subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/ShortCode.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The minimum length rises above the generated length of 8, so a generated code fails its own re-validation.

blocks: packages/core/posts/tests/unit/CreatePostUseCase.test.ts::creates a post without errors when media is an empty array
subject: packages/core/posts/src/CreatePostUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The persistence check is inverted, so a post created with an empty media array that persists returns an error instead of its id.

blocks: packages/core/posts/tests/unit/CreatePostUseCase.test.ts::creates a post without errors when media field is omitted
subject: packages/core/posts/src/CreatePostUseCase.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The media loop loses its default for an omitted field, so a post created without media throws on iterating undefined.

blocks: packages/core/posts/tests/unit/CreatePostUseCase.test.ts::creates a post successfully when media contains a valid image item
subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/MediaAttachment.ts
note: The ledger row's subject is CreatePostUseCase.ts, which delegates the media type check to the post aggregate; the verdict, that an image item is accepted, comes from MEDIA_TYPES in MediaAttachment.ts. The list loses image, so a post with an image item returns VALIDATION_FAILED.

blocks: packages/core/posts/tests/unit/CreatePostUseCase.test.ts::creates a post successfully when media contains a valid video item
subject: packages/core/domain/src/value-objects/MediaAttachment.ts
note: The ledger row's subject is CreatePostUseCase.ts, which delegates the media type check to the post aggregate; the verdict, that a video item is accepted, comes from MEDIA_TYPES in MediaAttachment.ts. The list loses video, so a post with a video item returns VALIDATION_FAILED.

blocks: packages/core/threading/tests/unit/threadPlanner.test.ts::returns ok for a plan that satisfies all constraints
subject: packages/core/threading/src/threadPlanner.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The thread length check of validateThreadPlan is inverted, so a two-tweet plan inside every limit is refused as CONTENT_TOO_LONG.
